rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a place where crops are grown or livestock is raised.

example.english: I often went to the farm to see cows when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個成日去農場睇牛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 heoi3 nung4 coeng4 tai2 ngau4

rows.note: A speaker picks this for a farm presented as an estate or farmstead, often including buildings or visitor facilities.

example.english: This farm has guesthouses and a restaurant.
example.traditional: 呢個農莊有民宿同餐廳。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 nung4 zong1 jau5 man4 suk1 tung4 caan1 teng1
